caloric_theory.title: Caloric: heat as a conserved self-repellent fluid (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Lavoisier & Laplace (1783). Memoire sur la chaleur (caloric as a material fluid).

caloric_theory.ground_truth_hypothesis: Heat is a weightless, conserved material fluid called caloric whose self-repulsive particles flow from hot to cold bodies; the total quantity of caloric in the universe is fixed, and temperature reflects the density of caloric within a body.

cold_fusion.title: Room-temperature nuclear fusion in palladium electrodes (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Fleischmann & Pons (1989). Electrochemically induced nuclear fusion of deuterium. J. Electroanal. Chem. 261:301–308.

cold_fusion.ground_truth_hypothesis: Electrolysis of heavy water at a palladium cathode drives deuterium nuclei to fuse at room temperature, releasing excess heat far beyond any chemical process.

lamarckian_inheritance.title: Inheritance of acquired characteristics (Lamarckism) as the mechanism of evolution (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Lamarck, J.-B. (1809). Philosophie zoologique (inheritance of acquired characteristics).

lamarckian_inheritance.ground_truth_hypothesis: Characteristics an organism acquires through use or disuse during its lifetime are transmitted to its offspring; repeated use strengthens and enlarges an organ, disuse weakens it, and these somatic modifications are inherited, driving the progressive transformation of species.

luminiferous_aether.title: The luminiferous aether as the medium for light propagation (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Fresnel, A. (1818). Memoire sur la diffraction de la lumiere.

luminiferous_aether.ground_truth_hypothesis: Light propagates as a mechanical wave through an all-pervading elastic medium, the luminiferous aether, which fills all space and supports transverse oscillations; the Earth's motion through this stationary aether should produce a measurable directional dependence in the speed of light.

miasma_theory.title: Miasma: disease caused by bad air from decaying matter (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Farr, W. (1852). Report on the mortality of cholera (elevation/miasma correlation).

miasma_theory.ground_truth_hypothesis: Epidemic diseases such as cholera are caused by miasma — a poisonous vapour emanating from rotting organic matter and foul air — and the incidence of disease is determined by proximity to and concentration of this bad air rather than by a transmissible living agent.

n_rays.title: N-rays: a novel radiation emitted by most materials (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Blondlot, R. (1903). Sur une nouvelle espece de lumiere. Comptes Rendus 136:666.

n_rays.ground_truth_hypothesis: Most materials (metals, treated steel, even the human nervous system) emit a new form of radiation, N-rays, which increases the brightness of a small electric spark and can be refracted by an aluminium prism into a spectrum.

phlogiston.title: Phlogiston as the substance released during combustion (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Stahl, G.E. (1703). Specimen Beccherianum (systematic exposition of phlogiston theory).

phlogiston.ground_truth_hypothesis: Combustible bodies contain a material substance, phlogiston, which is released into the air during burning; a body ceases to burn when the surrounding air becomes saturated with phlogiston.
